description: Resource errors. If there are no errors or warnings, then the array value will be empty.

first_reported_timestamp.description: The timestamp of the first event that reported this condition.

latest_event.description: The latest notification event that was generated for the corresponding condition

severity.description: Severity of the condition, same as the event

info.description: The information from the notification event that was generated by the condition.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 timestamp at which this event was created
